provenance.limitations: This is a frozen public challenge set, not an independent blind test or real-user dataset.

documents.content:
Access control policy

Read-only project tools may run without interruption. Any operation that creates or changes a project artifact requires an explicit approval attached to that individual call. A previous approval cannot be reused for another write.

Administrative access to the host is outside the workbench permission model and is never delegated to an agent.

Credential handling standard

Provider credentials are loaded from server-side environment variables. They must not be accepted in browser payloads, written into prompts, copied into traces, or returned by an API response.

Rotating a credential does not authorize a model to inspect the new value.

Session lifecycle

A new conversation starts at version zero. A successful continuation must present the current version and advances it by one. Stale concurrent updates are rejected, while failed requests do not advance the stored version.

Expired sessions are removed according to the configured time-to-live policy.

Audit and retention

Each attempted tool call records its tool name, status, elapsed time and sanitized error type in append-only JSONL. Raw prompts, source contents, credentials and free-form tool output are excluded from the trace.

Retention duration is deployment-specific; this document does not promise permanent storage.

Container execution profile

Execution is disabled by default. When enabled by an operator, the container uses a digest-pinned local image, no network, a read-only root filesystem, a non-root numeric user, dropped capabilities and bounded CPU, memory, process count and output.

Only project inputs, work and outputs are mounted; the Docker socket and host secrets are never mounted.

MCP admission policy

Only operator-configured stdio servers and explicitly allowlisted read-only tools are admitted. Discovered input schemas and safety annotations are validated, and the complete tool definition fingerprint is checked again immediately before every call.

Remote tool descriptions are replaced with short local descriptions before they enter model context.

MCP residual risks

The SDK applies the application output limit after parsing a complete protocol message. An untrusted server could therefore consume host memory before the limit is evaluated.

Servers outside the operator trust boundary require separate container or microVM isolation with operating-system resource limits.

Retrieval quality controls

The lexical baseline combines English tokens and Chinese bigrams. Optional local embeddings add semantic similarity and rerank the same chunks; an initialization or encoding error must be reported as lexical-fallback rather than hidden.

Recall at k and reciprocal rank are measured on frozen cases, not inferred from answer fluency.

Citation verification

A retrieval result is not trusted merely because a tool returned it. Before writing a report, the agent reopens the project-relative source and verifies the path, start line, end line, citation label and exact quoted text.

Claims without matching supplied evidence must be refused rather than filled from model memory.

Hosted provider reliability

Transient provider failures use a small bounded retry policy. Three consecutive logical failures open an in-process circuit breaker for thirty seconds; after cooldown, only a probe request is allowed.

Permanent protocol errors are surfaced immediately and are not retried.

Trajectory budgets

Every model trajectory has independent limits for model calls, turns, input tokens, output tokens and reported dollar cost. Tool steps are counted separately by the runtime. Crossing either budget stops execution instead of silently continuing.

If a provider omits monetary cost, the value remains unavailable rather than being recorded as zero.

Context management

System instructions and recent conversational turns are retained first. Older history may be summarized, while a large structured tool result is trimmed without removing its JSON wrapper, status, error fields, or leading and trailing evidence.

Tool calls and their corresponding results are treated as atomic groups during compaction.

Attachment bridge

The browser may read user-selected UTF-8 Markdown and text files and send their contents to the same-origin service. It does not transmit the local absolute path. The service repeats project-relative path checks and a 200 KB per-file limit.

PDF, Office documents, archives and executable files are not accepted by the current bridge.

Project isolation

Project identity is derived from user, conversation and feature identifiers. File resolution rejects absolute paths, parent traversal and links that escape the assigned project root. Different conversations receive different project directories.

The browser cannot choose a server-side workspace directory.

Concurrency control

Each project has a runtime-owned execution lock. A specialist handoff reuses the same runtime and lock; delegation cannot create a second step budget or bypass an in-progress operation.

Session version checks protect persisted conversation updates, while the project lock protects tool execution.

Untrusted source instructions

Text retrieved from a document is evidence, not authority. Phrases that request instruction override, secret disclosure or command execution are marked as risk signals but are never executed.

Pattern matching is diagnostic only; enforceable protection comes from tool allowlists, permissions, path checks and process isolation.

Supervisor boundary

The research supervisor classifies a request as evidence retrieval or cross-document synthesis. It owns no tools. Both specialists receive the original shared runtime, so routing cannot reset permissions, trace state, project locks or step budgets.

A routing decision includes a stable reason code and confidence level without storing the task text in trace.

Evaluation discipline

Development examples, deterministic regression cases and independent blind tasks are reported separately. A blind set is sealed together with the routing source hash before evaluation. Once revealed, it becomes diagnostic data and cannot be presented as a fresh blind result.

Failed gates and per-case errors are retained rather than removed to improve the headline score.

Backup scope

The demonstration workspace stores artifacts on the local filesystem. Backup frequency, geographic replication and disaster-recovery objectives are deployment responsibilities and are not implemented by the workbench.

No hourly backup or guaranteed recovery time is promised.

隐私与数据出站边界

离线检索和确定性路由不会把资料发送给外部模型。只有明确启用托管 Provider 时，任务、会话上下文和必要的工具结果才可能离开本机，因此界面必须提示这一边界。

浏览器不能覆盖服务端配置的模型地址、密钥或 MCP 命令。
